notablePrerequisites: Opponents control at least eight artifacts and/or enchantments.
description:
Activate Kiki-Jiki by tapping it, creating a token copy of Dockside Extortionist with haste.
The Dockside Extortionist token enters the battlefield, creating at least eight Treasure tokens.
Activate seven Treasure tokens by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {5}{G}{G}.
Cast Wurmcalling with buyback by paying a total of at least {5}{G}{G}.
Raggadragga's third ability triggers, giving Kiki-Jiki +7/+7 until end of turn and untapping Kiki-Jiki.
Resolve Wurmcalling, creating a Wurm creature token and returning Wurmcalling to your hand.
Repeat.
